one_line_thesis: Dorchester Minerals is a passive royalty MLP that pays quarterly cash tied to oil and gas prices and acquired acreage.

deep_dive.executive_summary: Dorchester Minerals is a passive royalty MLP that pays quarterly cash tied to oil and gas prices and acquired acreage. FY2025 distributions were $2.78 per unit on $152.8 million of revenue; Q1 2026 activity improved versus the prior-year quarter per the March 2026 10-Q. The partnership funds growth primarily by issuing common units for mineral exchanges (Colorado and Permian deals in 2024-2025). At about $27 per unit and $2.78 starting distributions, Marvin's Lawrence base case is 13.8% per year over seven years, a watch stance just below our mid-teens bar.
